name: @ship/deck-router
description: Deck route surface — URL state as reactive signals, navigate(), setRouterPort, mergeRoutes, and the edit-mode toggle. Owns the SHAPES/INSTANCES registries and the popstate listener; the SUI runtime imports it as a thin re-export for backwards compatibility, but the canonical home is here.
//: SRC-DIRECT (like sui-runtime/sui-dom/deck-host). The deck bake compiles framework-singleton SRC in-process via resolve_entry's manifest `main`; pointing at a built dist/ let dist go stale relative to src (e.g. the lazy-mountRouter change shipped to src but a stale dist served the eager build). Resolving to src means the bundle always reflects source — no separate `tsc` build to keep in sync.
